I suggested two easy routes: Tobias gets the rate from June directly, or June sends me the figure and confirms it's OK. Either way, I'll then draft the mail to Tobias (trendle@pemberline.com, an internal address, so no outside-mail approval is needed). I've offered to ask June, but haven't done it yet. I didn't file an approval request either, because without the figure there's nothing ready to approve.
